limitations: Applies to dominated proper colorings of incidence graphs of existing finite projective planes of order \(q\ge2\), with open-neighborhood domination, optimum class count, and single-vertex recoloring that preserves optimum; no assertion about near-optimal colorings or nonexisting planes.
scientific_integrity: The general theorem follows from an explicit cover and support-rigidity proof; finite enumerations at the two finite orders checked are checks only. The minimum-color number is already implied by earlier literature and is not claimed as new. Independent external audit and publication-priority certification have not been performed.
title: Pencil rigidity and recoloring components of dominated colorings in finite projective planes
